title: Hashgrid DNA: You search. DNA learns.
excerpt: DNA is a search engine that learns from your feedback. Bring your items and any embedding model, score the results with an LLM or your users' clicks, and every search gets better with fewer LLM calls.
content_html:
The search engine that learns from feedback. Smarter and cheaper with every search.

Your models. Our search.

local

local

Embedder

Data in, vectors out. Any model works.

DNA

Finds the best result. Learns from every score.

Judge

An LLM, a small model, or your users.

Simple, as it should be.

Send embeddings, search, and send back a score when you have one. DNA trains on its side, so you don't host or tune a model.

Nodes can be tools, products, documents, people, or anything else you can imagine.

Read the quick start

Anonymous by design.

DNA never receives your data, your prompts or who your users are. Swap embedders or LLMs anytime.

What DNA sees

{ "id": "93d77a9cf9dcdcbb",
  "key": "42",
  "emb": [0.0123, -0.0456, 0.0871, …] }

{ "id": "f43125171437b656",
  "score": 0.72 }

What does it cost?

7× fewer LLM calls than standard retrieval, on average.

Built for searches like these. And yours.
